name: Recovery Manager
implementation: Round 2 tri-state fee audit: deterministic rules per charge type against upstream evidence (default, no model call); optional one batched Gemini call per unit (RECOVERY_MODEL_MODE=live) for charge types no rule covers.
description: Reads the fee report lines for a unit and every earlier evidence record; CONTRADICTS = claim with cited records, SUPPORTS = no claim, SILENT = never claimed.
